title: Pak Choi Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with pak choi, nourishing vegetables, and a hint of Spanish flair.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the pak choi and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
